Next, a solution of aldehyde 25 (2.57 g, 6.09 mmol, 10:1 mixture of C-19 diastereomers) in Et2O (120 mL) was added over 30 minutes (syringe pump). The reaction was allowed to stir an additional 2 h and was the quenched with saturated aqueous ammonium chloride (100 mL). Mixture was warmed to ambient temperature and stirred vigorously until complete consumption of magnesium was observed. The aqueous layer was then extracted with Et2O (3 x 100 mL) and the combined organic extracts were dried over anhydrous Na2SO4, filtered and concentrated in vacuo.
